description: Measures frame time, memory, load time and draw calls against a budget and names the specific cost. Diagnoses only; the fix is a code or asset change afterwards.
when_to_use: the game stutters, hitches, or loads slowly
memory or frame budget is being exceeded
a performance claim needs measuring rather than guessing
avoid_when: the cause is already measured and the request is to fix it
the complaint is about feel rather than measurable cost
